reasons.text: All file uploads pass through the API gateway
The API gateway enforces a 10 MB request body limit

decisions.title: Serve EU customers from Frankfurt only

reasons.text: All EU customers are in Germany and Austria
We sell to customers in the European Union

decisions.title: Rebuild the search index in full every night

reasons.text: Our Elasticsearch mapping cannot take incremental updates

decisions.title: Run the data pipeline hourly, not continuously

reasons.text: Warehouse query cost scales with how often the pipeline runs
We are on BigQuery on-demand pricing
Tooling and infrastructure spend must stay under $20,000 a month

queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[o:OWNS]->(d:Decision) WHERE o.valid_from <= $as_of AND ($id IS NULL OR d.id = $id) RETURN d.id, p.id, p.name, p.role, o.valid_from, o.valid_to, o.handed_over_from ORDER BY d.id, o.valid_from

MATCH (d:Decision) OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Decision)-[su:SUPERSEDES]->(d) WHERE su.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(su.stated, su.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (x:Evidence)-[rt:RETIRES]->(d) WHERE rt.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(rt.stated, rt.at) <= $as_of WITH d, coalesce(n.id, x.id) AS sup OPTIONAL MATCH p = (d)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..4]->(pr:Premise) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[r:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]->(pr) WHERE r.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(r.stated, r.at) <= $as_of WITH d, sup, pr, collect({rel: type(r), at: r.at, stated: r.stated, kind: e.kind}) AS ev OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:System) RETURN d, sup, pr.id, ev, collect(DISTINCT s.name) ORDER BY d.id

MATCH (p:Person)-[o:OWNS]->(d:Decision) WHERE o.valid_from <= $as_of AND ($id IS NULL OR d.id = $id) RETURN d.id, p.id, p.name, p.role, o.valid_from, o.valid_to, o.handed_over_from ORDER BY d.id, o.valid_from

MATCH (o:Person {id: $pid}) MATCH path = (o)-[:REPORTS_TO*1..5]->(m:Person) WHERE all(r IN relationships(path) WHERE r.valid_from <= $at AND (r.valid_to = '' OR r.valid_to > $at)) AND (m.left = '' OR m.left > $as_of) RETURN m.id, m.name, m.role, [n IN nodes(path) | {id: n.id, name: n.name, role: n.role, left: n.left}], length(path) ORDER BY length(path) LIMIT 1

MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Decision)-[su:SUPERSEDES]->(d) WHERE su.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(su.stated, su.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (x:Evidence)-[rt:RETIRES]->(d) WHERE rt.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(rt.stated, rt.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:RECORDED_IN]->(src:Evidence) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:System) RETURN d, n.id, n.title, su.at, x.id, x.title, rt.at, rt.quote, src, collect(DISTINCT s.name)

MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) MATCH p = (d)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..4]->(pr:Premise) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[r:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]->(pr) WHERE r.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(r.stated, r.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(e) RETURN pr, nodes(p) AS pn, length(p) AS hops, collect({id: e.id, title: e.title, kind: e.kind, date: e.date, rel: type(r), at: r.at, stated: r.stated, quote: r.quote, author: a.name}) ORDER BY hops
